name: apache-ant
description: The Apache Ant package is a Java-based build tool. In theory, it is like the make command, but without make's wrinkles. Ant is extended using Java classes and XML-based configuration files.

package:
cat > $DESTDIR/etc/profile.d/ant.sh << 'EOF'
# Begin /etc/profile.d/ant.sh

pathappend /opt/ant/bin
export ANT_HOME=/opt/ant

# End /etc/profile.d/ant.sh
EOF
